description: This file contains implementation code for Wi-Fi CSI (Channel State Information) processing, including functions to process CSI data, manage CSI sounding sessions, and initialize the CSI application interface within a Wi-Fi management software. It interacts with Wi-Fi hardware and control modules, manages internal data structures for tracking CSI sessions, and provides external API functions for starting and stopping CSI measurements.

methods.name: INT process_csi(mac_address_t mac_addr,wifi_csi_data_t * csi_data)
methods.description: Handles incoming CSI data, creates a Wi-Fi event, and dispatches it via the apps manager.

methods.name: void update_pinger_config(int ap_index,mac_addr_t mac_addr,bool pause_pinger)
methods.description: Updates configuration for pinger (CSI measurement trigger), conditioned on compile-time flags.

methods.name: int csi_start_fn(void * csi_app,unsigned int ap_index,mac_addr_t mac_addr,int sounding_app)
methods.description: Starts CSI measurement for a specific MAC address, handles multiple apps subscribing to CSI data, and manages resource limits.

methods.name: int csi_stop_fn(void * csi_app,unsigned int ap_index,mac_addr_t mac_addr,int sounding_app)
methods.description: Stops CSI measurement for a specific MAC address and updates internal session tracking.

methods.name: int csi_init(wifi_app_t * app,unsigned int create_flag)
methods.description: Initializes the CSI application, sets function pointers, creates data structures, and registers callback functions.

ctags.name: csi_start_fn
ctags.pattern: /^int csi_start_fn(void* csi_app, unsigned int ap_index, mac_addr_t mac_addr, int sounding_app)$/

ctags.name: csi_stop_fn
ctags.pattern: /^int csi_stop_fn(void* csi_app, unsigned int ap_index, mac_addr_t mac_addr, int sounding_app)$/

ctags.pattern: /^void update_pinger_config(int ap_index, mac_addr_t mac_addr, bool pause_pinger)$/
